properties.name: ACCESSIBLE
properties.anchor: USAFacts anchor: machine-readable access matters most. FCSM bridge: Utility → accessibility, timeliness.

properties.name: ACCURATE
properties.anchor: USAFacts anchor: hold retrieval-paired systems to accuracy evaluations. FCSM bridge: Objectivity → accuracy, reliability. This is the EVAL-heavy criterion and the probe machinery's second life.

properties.indicator: Documented public API; auth model; rate limits stated
Full-product bulk download exists and is linked from product page
robots.txt + AI-crawler policy permit retrieval; no soft-blocks on data paths
llms.txt (or equivalent) present; sitemap covers data products
schema.org/Dataset (or DCAT/Croissant) markup valid on product pages
Persistent URLs/DOIs for products and vintages
Release date machine-readable; latest-vintage pointer resolvable
Product exposes a machine-first entry point (documented API plus MCP/A2A-class endpoint or equivalent agent protocol); human pages derivable from it

Interactive data tools expose stable, directly-requestable deep links; meaningful states are not fragment-only or session-dependent; invalid routes return true 404/410, not HTTP-200 shell (soft-404); page-specific content present in raw HTML before JS execution
properties.evidence_raw: internal draft: FSS Machine Diagnostic spec (SEO SME, 2026-09, operator-held; admission gated)

properties.indicator: A4 upgraded from declared-policy check to three-layer comparison: declared (robots.txt/meta directives) vs enforced (edge/WAF/bot-management treatment) vs observed (actual crawler request logs). A mismatch between layers is itself the finding, not an error state
properties.tier_raw: `agency_instrumented` (observed leg requires edge logs; declared leg stays `public`)
properties.evidence_raw: `cloudflare-ai-crawl-control-manage-crawlers`; `rfc-9309-robots-exclusion-protocol`; internal draft: FSS Machine Diagnostic spec (as above)

properties.indicator: Comprehensive variable-level metadata (labels, definitions, units, universes)
Concept/term definitions published, versioned, linked from variables
Methodology docs in structured text (not PDF-only); summarizable by retrieval
Data-quality attributes (error measures, suppression rules, revisions policy) published as metadata, not prose
Same concept ⇒ same identifier across products/vintages
Plain-language product summary present and current (the retrieval target)
Benchmark question set per product; answer accuracy of a retrieval-paired model vs published values
Entailment-judged: do model statements about the product entail from product text? (probe protocol, re-aimed)
Version/vintage disambiguation: does retrieval return the vintage asked for?
Generative engines citing the product cite the authoritative page (not aggregators)
Product scored against published AI-data-readiness metrics
Explicit machine-readable license/terms on product and API
Terms address model training/retrieval use explicitly
Source lineage published (collection → processing → product)

properties.indicator: Statutory products enumerable from a public inventory (data.gov/agency inventory current)
Product spec conformance (AUTO/DOC set) reported separately from fit-for-use evals (EVAL set); a product cannot pass validation while failing verification
properties.evidence_raw: `nist-ai-risk-management-framework-ai-rmf`; internal: this instrument's A/B/D vs C split

properties.indicator: Published pass/fail thresholds per eval, pre-registered before results; threshold changes are versioned events
Eval sets and rubrics carry versions; results never pooled across versions
Public eval sets have a held-out rotation; publication schedule assumes training-set leakage within one model generation
Seeded known-bad items (canaries/decoys) in every continuous-eval cycle; a cycle with zero fired controls is INVALID, not passing
Discrepancy taxonomy localizing failures to retrieval / vintage / metadata / model; each stage instrumented
Documented path from failed eval back into the data product (metadata fix, vintage pointer, dictionary entry) with re-test; mean-time-to-closure tracked
Versioned golden question/answer sets re-run on schedule against the product surface; baseline deltas alarmed; state fidelity across product versions measured, not assumed

Standing adversarial bank: vintage traps, confusable series, unit traps, DP-noise misreads, suppression probes; plus surface red team — misparse and injection resistance of pages/markup/llms.txt. Reported as break modes, not just pass rates
New releases pass a published expectation suite (schema validity, row/total sanity, identifier persistence) before going live
API/schema changes are versioned; breaking changes announced with deprecation windows; compatibility checked mechanically
Time-series identifiers, geography codes, and endpoints survive a new vintage or a crosswalk is published; tested per release
Machine-readable changelog per release (what changed, why, revision class); webhooks/push for high-frequency products
Canary/staging surface for major product changes; AI-consumer regression run before promotion
Signed releases / provenance attestations so downstream copies are traceable to the authoritative artifact (SLSA-class, adapted)

properties.indicator: **G1-O (observed)** — the family preservation rate (the L3+ share of scored qualifier families, D9) when the pinned consumer restates that same captured surface at indirect compression `none`, reported per surface with the `unparseable` share and the `short` / `tight` rates beside it, every record stamped with consumer, prompt epoch, `parser_version` and `scorer_version` (`g1_preservation.py`). The two legs are reported as a vector and are never composited (protocol §3). **No product-level PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL in v0.2.x:** the rate and its Wilson interval are the score until the January calibration run sets a boundary. Compression is a reported condition, not a scored one, until intended use says which condition the consumer of the assessment cares about

properties.indicator: Revision status machine-readable per value (preliminary/revised/final/benchmark), with scheduled-revision dates; EVAL: vintage disambiguation (ties C3)
Stable series IDs; machine-readable crosswalks when classifications or geographies change (industry codes, boundary revisions)
Issuing authority, statutory mandate, and statistical-vs-administrative provenance carried as structured metadata — the trust signal AI rankers need to prefer authoritative sources over aggregators
Suppression and disclosure-avoidance documented machine-readably with unique identifiers (strengthens the guide's own bullet from prose to spec)

Collection instrument/protocol carried as a versioned epoch on the series; changes annotated machine-readably with reason and inter-epoch crosswalk (SDMX break-in-series class metadata). The consumer-side test: an AI system asked to compare values across a break must surface the break

properties.signal: HTTP GET the product page; extract every download link; for each, HEAD and read Content-Type and file extension. Structured iff any of csv/json/parquet/xlsx/xml; PDF-only iff every link is application/pdf.
properties.evidence_kind: response headers + link list + body sha256

properties.signal: HTTP GET the documented API base and any OpenAPI/Swagger document; record auth scheme, declared rate limits, and whether the description is machine-readable.
Crawl the product page one hop; classify links as bulk (whole-product archive or full dataset file) vs filtered query.
HTTP GET /robots.txt; parse; evaluate Allow/Disallow for the product path per user-agent in the AI-crawler list (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Bingbot).
HTTP GET /sitemap.xml (and the path robots.txt declares), /llms.txt, /.well-known/; parse the sitemap and test whether the product URL is covered.
properties.evidence_kind: sitemap tree + coverage verdict for the product URL

properties.signal: Extract embedded JSON-LD / microdata / RDFa from the product page; test for schema.org Dataset or DCAT; validate the DCAT graph against DCAT-AP SHACL shapes.
Read Last-Modified and any dcterms:modified / schema.org dateModified in the markup; test whether a latest-vintage pointer resolves.
Probe for a machine-first entry point: OpenAPI at the documented base, /.well-known/mcp or an advertised MCP/A2A endpoint, /llms.txt.
For an interactive data tool: request a deep link and an invalid route; compare status codes and pre-JS HTML; a soft-404 is HTTP 200 with an error shell. Render once to compare pre- and post-JS DOM.
properties.evidence_kind: status codes + raw HTML + rendered DOM
properties.prior_art: internal draft: FSS Machine Diagnostic spec (operator-held)

properties.signal: The DECLARED layer only: robots.txt and meta-robots directives for the product path. The enforced and observed layers need edge/WAF logs and are agency_instrumented.
Fetch the methodology document; test whether it is structured text (HTML/markdown) or PDF-only, and whether it is retrievable without JS.
properties.note: NOT in the task's §3 list; derived from the framework as public-tier and AUTO/DOC. Reported as a discrepancy.

properties.signal: Given a generative engine's answer citing the product, resolve the cited URL and test whether it is the authoritative agency page or an aggregator.
properties.evidence_kind: cited URL + resolution chain + authority verdict
properties.note: The AUTO leg needs a generative engine's citations as input, which is the EVAL half of the indicator. No open-source collector produces them; this is genuinely blocked on the harness.

properties.signal: Read the licence from schema.org/DCAT markup, an HTTP Link header, and the API's terms endpoint; test whether it is a recognised identifier (SPDX or a known URL) rather than free text.
Fetch /data.json (Project Open Data catalog); validate against the POD v1.1 schema; test whether the product appears in it.
properties.evidence_kind: catalog document + validation report + membership verdict

properties.signal: Both control fixtures are scanned before any real host. A cycle in which either produced an unexpected verdict is INVALID.
properties.evidence_kind: per-fixture verdict map for every rule in the cycle
properties.note: Was `none_known`: a seeded canary is a property of the harness's own cycle, not an observation of an external surface. Task §4 makes the fixtures that property.

properties.signal: Compare the API/schema description across two releases; detect breaking changes and test for a declared deprecation window.
properties.note: Needs a version history; a single-point scan cannot observe stability. Becomes collectible once the scan runs twice.

properties.signal: Across a vintage transition, test whether series identifiers, geography codes and endpoints survive, or a crosswalk is published.
properties.note: Same shape as F2: requires two vintages.

properties.signal: Fetch any changelog or release-notes endpoint; test whether it is machine-readable and carries a revision class per entry.
On the captured product surface, test whether error measures (MOE, CV, SE, CI, DP noise parameters) are present as STRUCTURED FIELDS beside the estimates rather than as footnotes.
Test for stable series IDs across vintages and a published crosswalk when a classification or geography changes.
